Name: Syanide23's Fruit Bats for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from Syanide23, I've converted their BFAV Fruit Bats (found at https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16143) to ContentPatcher to work on SDV 1.6. Credit to Syanide23 for the original mod

Fruit Bats live in coops and will drop their corresponding fruits (Apples bats drop apples, Cherry bats drop cherries, etc).

Enjoy!
